q: 1. The edge of drawing board where T-square is made to slide is called
explain: The working edge (or ebony edge) is a perfectly straight wooden strip on the left side of the drawing board used to guide the T-square.

q: 2. As per ISI recommended size of drawing board is/are
explain: ISI (Indian Standards Institution) specifies these standard sizes for drawing boards to ensure uniformity in technical drawings.

q: 3. Working edge of drawing board is kept ........... of the user.
explain: For right-handed users, the ebony/working edge is always on the left so the T-square can be manipulated by the left hand while drawing with the right.

q: 4. Vertical lines are drawn
explain: Standard drafting practice is to draw vertical lines from top to bottom for better control and visibility of the line being drawn.

q: 5. Set squares are not used to draw
explain: Horizontal lines are primarily drawn using the T-square or a mini-drafter; set squares are typically used for vertical and inclined lines relative to the T-square.

q: 6. For drawing large-size circles .................. is attached to the compass (>150mm).
explain: A lengthening bar is an extension that increases the radius of the compass beyond its standard limit.

q: 7. Circles of small radii are drawn by means of a
explain: Bow compasses are rigid and small, making them ideal for maintaining precision while drawing small circles.

q: 8. .......... is used for setting of short equal distances.
explain: Bow dividers are used for repeating small, equal measurements along a line accurately.

q: 9. In drafting machine, which one does not follow
explain: A drafting machine (mini-drafter) combines the functions of a T-square, set squares, and protractor, but has nothing to do with leveling equipment.

q: 10. .............is used to protect the adjoining lines on the drawing when some parts of the line is being erased.
explain: An erasing shield is a thin metal or plastic plate with holes of various shapes that allows erasing a specific area without disturbing nearby lines.

q: 11. Parallel ruling straight edge machine is used to draw
explain: A parallel ruling straight-edge is a drafting machine attachment that slides vertically on wires/cords while remaining horizontal, used primarily to draw horizontal parallel lines.

q: 12. Uses of the T-square, set squares, scale and protractor are combined in the
explain: A drafting machine (or mini-drafter) is an all-in-one tool that replaces several individual drafting instruments.

q: 13. Which of the following pencil leads is hardest?
explain: On the pencil grading scale, 'H' denotes hardness (higher H numbers = harder); among HB, H, B, F, the H grade is the hardest listed.

q: 14. To lay off an angle from a given line, what marks on the protractor should you align for a higher accuracy?
explain: For accurate angle layout, the protractor's center mark must be aligned with the vertex of the angle, and the 0°–180° baseline aligned with the reference line, so all three (0°, 180°, and center) marks are used together.

q: 15. The most important material for drawing is
explain: Paper (the drawing surface) and pencil (the marking tool) are the two most basic and essential materials for any drawing.

q: 16. Which pencil is used for thinner line ?
explain: The 'H' stands for Hardness. Higher numbers (like 2H) have harder lead, which produces thinner, lighter lines.

q: 17. To draw smooth curves of any nature, drafting instrument used is .............
explain: A French curve is a flexible-shaped template specifically designed to help draw smooth irregular curves that are not simple arcs of a circle.

q: 18. 9H pencil is ......than the 7H pencil
explain: In the pencil grading system, 9H is the hardest grade available, making it harder than 7H.

q: 19. The equipment mainly used to transfer the measurements is
explain: Dividers have two sharp points specifically intended to pick up distances from a scale and transfer them to the work without marking the original source.

q: 20. The latter 'H' labeled in a Drawing Pencil indicates
explain: The 'H' grading on a pencil denotes the relative hardness of its lead.

q: 21. French curve is used to draw
explain: French curves are templates for non-circular, mathematically irregular curves like ellipses or parabolas.

q: 22. Hard pencils are best used in .............
explain: Hard pencils (higher H grade) produce fine, precise, light lines, making them well suited to landscape/detail drawings requiring delicate line work, as per this reference's classification.

q: 23. The drafting tool used to prepare a smooth curve line is called
explain: French curves are shaped templates specifically designed for drawing smooth curves that are not circular arcs.

q: 24. The most of the texture can be drawn with the help of drawing pen with line thickness
explain: For detailed texture and hatching, a specific medium-thick pen like 0.8mm is often used for emphasis.

q: 25. Graphos are:
explain: Graphos is a technical pen used for drawing and writing (lettering) with interchangeable nibs.

q: 26. Templates are used for:
explain: Drafting templates have cut-out shapes for both regular curves/circles and standard geometric areas, speeding up repetitive drawing tasks.

q: 27. For drawing large size circle is drawn by.....
explain: A lengthening bar attaches to a compass to extend its reach for drawing large circles.

q: 28. Unnecessary lines is removed by .....
explain: An eraser is the standard tool used to remove unwanted or incorrect pencil lines from a drawing.

q: 29. T square is used to draw .............
explain: The T-square's blade slides along the board's working edge, making it primarily suited for drawing horizontal lines (vertical and inclined lines require set squares used in conjunction with it).

q: 30. The equipment used to draft vertical and angular line is .............
explain: Vertical and angular (inclined) lines are drawn using a set square placed against the T-square's blade, combining both tools together.

q: 31. The purpose of making the drawing board with seasoned soft wood .............
options: for fixing of drawing paper with the help of drawing pin
explain: Seasoned soft wood is chosen for drawing boards mainly because it allows drawing pins to be easily pushed in and removed for fixing the paper, without damaging the board or the pins.

q: 32. Parallel ruling straight edge machine is used to draw .............
explain: A parallel ruling straight-edge, sliding vertically on guide wires while remaining horizontal, is designed primarily to draw horizontal parallel lines efficiently.

q: 33. French curve are used to draw .............
explain: A French curve is a template specifically shaped to guide the drawing of smooth irregular curves that are not simple circular arcs.
